ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central contiguous high-intensity region covering >85% of the surface area; low-intensity pigmentation mapping follows the entire trailing edge perimeter and extends deep into the median notch; isolated low-intensity pixel clusters are located near the peduncle attachment zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical notch depth is significant, measuring approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; the distal edge of the right lobe features a sequence of jagged peaks with pixel amplitudes between 10-20; medial sections of both lobes exhibit lower-amplitude, frequent irregular nicks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep trajectory on the distal-outer boundaries, curving vertically toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of low-intensity pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered low-intensity clusters visible at the lower-central region near the fluke-peduncle junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular sawtooth morphology and deep tissue indentations on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity specular highlights and edge-boundary blurring at the base and lobe tips caused by water spray/interaction.
